listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD (Sky Recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Skyward Sword HD desktop recompilation with documented Windows, Linux and macOS packages. The root diagram describes a precompiled sky game library while other text says no game code is included; exact selected-package/source contents remain unresolved. Supply your own version 1.0.0 prepared game files without updates. The launcher neither decrypts NSP/XCI nor accepts keys. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
